summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. Participants largely agree on keeping read support for backward compatibility while favoring Parquet (and potentially Vortex) for new writes, and suggest a migration guide if formats are deprecated. Benchmarks show conversion is quick for sequential IDs but can be slow for random UUID keys, raising concerns about contention with compaction in low‑latency commit scenarios. Iceberg 1.13.0 The discussion focuses on clarifying what "deterministic" means for user-defined functions used in stored expressions across different engines, highlighting its importance for check constraints, stats-only fields, and derived columns.
